# Templates

FLEXIcontent ships with four layouts (templates). Each template provides its own parameters for the item view and, for most of them, for the category view as well.

| Template | Description | Item options | Category options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **faq** | Groups and displays items as questions/answers | [99](./item.md) | [5](./category-faq.md) |
| **grid** | Columned layout with tiling ability | [99](./item.md) | [113](./category-grid.md) |
| **items-tabbed** | Items displayed as tabs | [99](./item.md) | [8](./category-items-tabbed.md) |
| **table** | Items displayed as a table | [99](./item.md) | [30](./category-table.md) |
